definition: Spastic ataxia 8 (SPAX8), autosomal recessive, with hypomyelinating leukodystrophy (OMIM #617560) is a rare neurogenetic disorder caused by bi-allelic pathogenic variants in the NKX6-2 gene. It presents along a clinical spectrum ranging from early-onset nystagmus, psychomotor delay, and cerebellar ataxia with hypotonia that rapidly progresses to severe spasticity, to a milder childhood-onset progressive spastic ataxia, frequently associated with neuroimaging hallmarks of central nervous system hypomyelination.

source.title: Genetic and phenotypic characterization of NKX6‐2‐related spastic ataxia and hypomyelination
source.quote: Bi-allelic mutations in NKX6-2 were recently linked to spastic ataxia 8 with hypomyelinating leukodystrophy.
